questions.q: Why must a legal address exist before you can register a legal entity in Oracle Fusion?
options: Oracle enforces the real-world fact that no legal entity exists without a registered address
Legal addresses are only needed for business units
The legal address is created automatically after the legal entity, not before
It is an optional convenience, not a requirement
questions.explain: The legal address must already exist (via Manage Legal Address) before registering a legal entity, mirroring the real-world requirement that every legal entity has a registered address.

questions.q: What four pieces of information does a legal entity registration require?
options: Only a name and a chart of accounts
Name, legal address, identifying jurisdiction, and jurisdiction-specific registration details
A ledger, a calendar, and a currency
A cost center, a natural account, and a balancing segment
questions.explain: Registration requires the legal entity name, a legal address, an identifying jurisdiction (such as United States Income Tax), and registration details like an EIN or TIN.

questions.q: What happens automatically the moment you register a new legal entity?
options: Nothing happens until a business unit is assigned
A primary ledger is created with the same name
A legal reporting unit with the same name as the entity is created automatically
A chart of accounts structure is generated
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion automatically creates a legal reporting unit matching the legal entity's name as soon as the entity is registered.

questions.q: When would a legal entity need more than one legal reporting unit?
options: Only when it has more than one business unit
Only when it uses a secondary ledger
Never — one legal entity can only ever have exactly one reporting unit
When it must register separately across multiple jurisdictions, such as several states
questions.explain: Additional legal reporting units are needed when a single legal entity has separate registrations in multiple jurisdictions, each requiring its own registration number.

questions.q: Which functional area hosts the Manage Legal Address, Manage Legal Entity, and Manage Legal Reporting Unit tasks?
options: Ledger and Reporting Configuration
Enterprise Profile
Subledger Accounting
Payables Invoicing
questions.explain: These legal-entity related tasks live in the Enterprise Profile functional area within the Financials offering.
